🔐 Sabiway API Documentation - Authentication

Authentication endpoints for integrating with the Sabiway backend.

Create a new user account.

Request Body:
{
  "full_name": "John Doe",
  "email": "john@example.com",
  "password": "yourpassword"
}

Response:
{
  "id": 1,
  "full_name": "John Doe",
  "email": "john@example.com"
}

Authenticate a user and return access + refresh tokens.

Request Body:
{
  "email": "john@example.com",
  "password": "yourpassword"
}

Response:
{
  "refresh": "refresh-token",
  "access": "access-token",
  "user": {
    "id": 1,
    "full_name": "John Doe",
    "email": "john@example.com"
  }
}

Login or signup using a Google ID token.

Request Body:
{
  "token": "google-oauth-id-token"
}

Response:
{
  "refresh": "refresh-token",
  "access": "access-token",
  "user": {
    "id": 1,
    "full_name": "Jane Doe",
    "email": "jane@gmail.com"
  },
  "is_new_user": false
}

Callback endpoint for Google OAuth2. Google redirects here with ?code=..., which is exchanged for tokens. 

Response:
{
  "refresh": "refresh-token",
  "access": "access-token",
  "user": {
    "id": 1,
    "full_name": "Jane Doe",
    "email": "jane@gmail.com"
  },
  "is_new_user": true
}

Generate the Google OAuth2 authorization URL. Your frontend can call this to redirect users to Google’s login page.

Response:
{
  "auth_url": "https://accounts.google.com/o/oauth2/v2/auth?client_id=XXXX&redirect_uri=XXXX&response_type=code&scope=openid%20email%20profile"
}

Send a reset code to the user’s email.

Request Body:
{
  "email": "john@example.com"
}

Response:
{
  "message": "Password reset instructions sent to email"
}

Verify the 4-digit reset code.

Request Body:
{
  "email": "john@example.com",
  "code": "1234"
}

Response:
{
  "message": "Code confirmed. You can now reset password.",
  "reset_token": "uuid-token"
}

Reset the user’s password using the reset token.

Request Body:
{
  "new_password": "newsecurepassword",
  "confirm_password": "newsecurepassword"
}

Response:
{
  "message": "Password has been reset successfully"
}

Logout the current user and blacklist refresh token.

Request Body:
{
  "refresh": "refresh-token"
}

Response:
{
  "detail": "Logout successful"
}

👨‍💻 Sabiway API Documentation - Admin Endpoints

Admin-only endpoints for managing users.

Retrieve a list of all users (admin only).

Response:
[
  {
    "id": 1,
    "full_name": "John Doe",
    "email": "john@example.com",
    "is_active": true,
    "is_staff": false,
    "is_superuser": false
  },
  {
    "id": 2,
    "full_name": "Jane Smith",
    "email": "jane@example.com",
    "is_active": true,
    "is_staff": true,
    "is_superuser": false
  }
]

Retrieve details of a single user (admin only).

Response:
{
  "id": 1,
  "full_name": "John Doe",
  "email": "john@example.com",
  "is_active": true,
  "is_staff": false,
  "is_superuser": false
}

Create a new user (admin only).

Request Body:
{
  "full_name": "Alice Johnson",
  "email": "alice@example.com",
  "password": "securepassword"
}

Response:
{
  "id": 3,
  "full_name": "Alice Johnson",
  "email": "alice@example.com",
  "is_active": true,
  "is_staff": false,
  "is_superuser": false
}

Update an existing user (admin only).

Request Body:
{
  "full_name": "Alice K. Johnson",
  "is_active": true,
  "is_staff": true
}

Response:
{
  "id": 3,
  "full_name": "Alice K. Johnson",
  "email": "alice@example.com",
  "is_active": true,
  "is_staff": true,
  "is_superuser": false
}

Delete a user (admin only).

Response:
{
  "message": "User deleted successfully"
}
